name: TopBar
description: A responsive application header combining scope, breadcrumb, search, status, account and host-defined actions.
signature: ({ module, scope, breadcrumb, status, search, actions, account, trailing, className, style, ...rest }: TopBarProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: account
props.description: Account identity displayed by the component.

props.name: actions
props.description: Supporting actions rendered in the action slot.

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: A Breadcrumb. On a phone it shows only the current place; give it a `header` (the module switch) and a `scope`.

props.name: module
props.description: Before the scope: the product's module switch (a Segmented: RMM · PSA · CHAT). Folds to its menu on a phone.

props.name: scope
props.description:
The context you work in: a ContextSwitcher (organisation, project, workspace). The
breadcrumb follows it after a separator. On a phone its trigger leaves the bar for the
breadcrumb's trail: give the Breadcrumb a `scope` that opens the switcher.

props.name: search
props.description: Search definition or controlled search value.

props.name: status
props.description: Live state that appears only while it runs (a TimerChip), after the breadcrumb.

props.name: trailing
props.description: The far right, after the account: the assistant toggle.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
